answer: Mesa bracket bond: every identity enters a mesa bracket, paired on work judged by ferrous scorecard; losers leave. A cedar seal binds each entry to its key; no operator can field one work twice. Three wins at 30 work each reach payout; one fake pays 200: 40 entry, 90 work, 70 lock, so 1,000 fakes pay 200,000 against a 40,000 pool. A hired ringer fails: its seal cannot match its entrant. An honest agent enters once, pays 40, keeps its bond.
